recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless OO wants to reverse FHIR-38951/FHIR-51702 and duplicate the SaMD/AI/ML wording back onto the Device page.
issue_request: FHIR-41428 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 OO change request to clarify in the Device and DeviceDefinition scope statements that software includes algorithms, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and similar software-based device forms.
initial_application: OO approved the request 10-0-0 on 2023-06-12. Commit 9876b481748f91838aa9c35a7ea6f84c29186af3 initially applied FHIR-41428 by adding a Software as a device AI/ML paragraph to source/device/device-introduction.xml, but did not update DeviceDefinition in that commit.
additional_context: Device and DeviceDefinition are active R6 resources in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issues FHIR-38951 and FHIR-51702 explicitly directed editors to remove the AI/ML paragraph from Device Scope and Usage and add/update the Software section in DeviceDefinition instead. Commit 43ec2e63cec03fdf90091d9ce7ffc329004bb2e7 implemented that later move. Current DeviceDefinition source includes SaMD, DTx, algorithms, artificial intelligence, and machine learning; current Device source still includes software application/algorithm scope text and links to DeviceDefinition for detailed device categories.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Reintroducing the removed AI/ML paragraph on Device would contradict later Applied Jira decisions, and the current DeviceDefinition source already carries the clarifying AI/ML content requested by FHIR-41428.
